# Vendored Three.js add-ons

`GLTFLoader.js`, `BufferGeometryUtils.js`, and `SkeletonUtils.js` come from Three.js 0.160.0. `GLTFLoader.js` has one local path adjustment so it can import `BufferGeometryUtils.js` from this directory. Three.js is distributed under the MIT license; its license text is in `THREE-LICENSE.txt`.
